title: gladiolus tristis subsp. spiralis
intro: Gladiolus tristis subsp. spiralis, commonly known as the 'Gladiolus', is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the family Iridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Gladiolus tristis subsp. spiralis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as cardiotonic, anti-hypertensive, and diuretic properties.
